Questions about payments
Which apps, when cards are charged, and what isn't supported yet.
Ask a question
Which payment apps can I use?
Stripe and PayPal, plus HitPay, BTCPayServer and Alby from the App Store. Connect one, then pick it on a link's Payments tab.
When is the card charged?
With "Collect payment on booking", the booker pays before the booking is confirmed. With "Charge no-show fee", the card is saved when they book and charged only if you mark them as a no-show, or automatically for last-minute cancellations if you turn that on.
Can I refund people who cancel?
Yes. Set the link's refund policy to Always, Never, or If cancelled a number of business or calendar days before the booking.
Is there a minimum price?
Stripe's minimum applies, for example $0.50 for payments in USD. Cal.com tells you if the price is below it.
Can I charge for recurring events or seats?
Not yet. Payments don't work with recurring events, and a link with seats can't charge a no-show fee.
